tests: all wire options retain UInt32 QoS and independent consume and publish flag bits
invalid flags and QoS ranges fail locally before source iteration or wire output
server flow notices pause new publications only on their channel and resume them
crossed flow requests keep delivery control replies separate from publisher notices
unsolicited flow does not consume the reply slot of a pending QoS RPC
flow command waits behind all frames of the same-channel source
server flow during a streamed body is notified now and acknowledged after the body
negative flow reply returns effective state without disabling outgoing messages
flow broker channel rejection is reported and sibling stays usable
missing flow response times out and terminates the connection
connection cancellation rejects pending flow without leaking its wait
recovery restores QoS size and noLocal snapshots before consumers but does not replay flow
failed local QoS does not overwrite a successfully recorded recovery setting
immediate option preserves confirms with both buffered and streamed sources
legacy bridge exports keep their calling convention and new flags exports agree
scope: Independent AMQP peer validates QoS width, consume/publish flags, both flow directions, source/RPC ordering, timeout/cancel, recovery snapshots and additive bridge compatibility; not full API or broker support.
